prompt: Two ramps lead to the same loading platform: one short and steep, one long and gentle. Pushing a heavy crate up the long, gentle ramp is easier mainly because it trades what for what?

options.text: Less force, applied over a longer distance
Less distance, for a larger force

explanation: An inclined plane spreads the work over a longer distance, so the force needed at any moment is smaller — the total work against gravity is the same.
